verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a terminal coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows `byteask exec`, which runs one task to completion and exits for use in scripts or CI. Any recurring schedule would come from external cron or CI, a host-platform or user-side workaround that earns no credit. No first-party scheduler or recurring-workflow feature is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
